transcript.text: Morning, Sam! Last time the 2-minute jogs felt easy, so we're bumping it up. Tonight at 6:30 pm, around your block: 2 min easy walk, then 3 min jog, 1 min walk, 3 rounds. Strava screenshot after. You said you'd get to that mile, and this gets you closer. You in?
Let's go, Sam! 🔥 6:30 tonight, 3-minute jogs, and I'll be waiting on that Strava screenshot.
Hey Sam! 6:30 is coming up, so get your shoes on and head to the block. 2 min walk warm-up, then 3 min jog, 1 min walk, 3 rounds. Send me that Strava screenshot when you're back. 🏃

checks.reason: Names the step: 2 min walk, 3 min jog, 1 min walk, 3 rounds, around the block, at 6:30 pm.
Opens with 'Morning, Sam!' as a self-started text.
Asks one thing, 'You in?', and never asks what time.
What, where and when are given, but total duration is only implied by '3 rounds' rather than stated.
Runs about five sentences, more than the one-to-three-sentence limit, though it is one question at the end.
Plain text with no markdown or hashtags.
Warm, sincere, energetic without being overfamiliar.
Two short sentences, no question, emoji used as punctuation.
Excited and warm, with a single emoji.
Restates the new step with time, place and steps: 2 min walk, 3 min jog, 1 min walk, 3 rounds, at 6:30.
Opens with 'Hey Sam!' as a self-started text.
Three short sentences and no question.
Purely encouraging, with no guilt or urgency.
Plain text with one emoji at the end.
Warm and energetic, appropriate for a check-in.

conversation.reason: The 9 am kickoff gives a new step built on the 2-minute jogs rather than the original 1-minute jogs, never asks the time, and the check-in refers to the new step.
The reply to 'yes let's go' restates the time and jog length, though neither had changed and neither was asked about.

grade.summary: ZOH avoided the regression: the kickoff builds on the 2-minute jogs, never re-asks the time, and the 6:20 check-in points to the new step. The main misses are a kickoff that runs past the short-text limit and a confirmation reply that restates the step.
